text: Mathematics is a fundamental discipline that studies concepts such as quantity, structure, space, change and information, and reveals the laws of the objective world through logical reasoning and abstract modeling. The mathematics major takes theoretical systems as its core, aiming to cultivate students' mastery of basic mathematical theories, calculation methods and application skills, as well as their rigorous logical thinking, problem modeling abilities and interdisciplinary application potential. It aims to supply compound talents for fields such as scientific research, education, finance and technology.
